propositions: Write/apply and subprocess paths rebuild config or reuse broad parent environments instead of using S2 runtime with operation bindings

Jira Cloud scope has implicit DIG fallbacks in write path, live access-check probe, runtime default, and create-time default that can write under unintended scope or leak Rebar-materialized credentials to unrelated siblings
Environment builder does not restrict credential visibility between adapters—all Rebar adapter secrets are ambient to all children rather than scoped to their owning process
Global os.environ is mutated by subprocess and apply paths instead of being isolated per operation

Four implicit DIG defaults exist in resolve_jira_settings, access_check probe, _CLOUD_PROJECT_DEFAULT constant, and _DEFAULT_PROJECT constant that allow requests to use DIG without explicit configuration
